documents.F01: Course registration (KRS) opens two weeks before the semester. Log in to the student portal, choose your classes, and ask your academic advisor to approve them.
documents.F02: Tuition fees must be paid before the registration deadline through the bank virtual account shown in the student portal.
documents.F03: Students with a GPA above 3.5 can apply for the merit scholarship. Applications open every August.
documents.F04: The central library is open from 8 am to 9 pm on weekdays and from 9 am to 3 pm on Saturdays.
documents.F05: Students may borrow up to five books for two weeks. Late returns are charged a small fine per day.
documents.F06: To graduate you must complete 144 credits, pass the thesis defense, and submit a TOEIC certificate.
documents.F07: Submit your thesis proposal to the department. A supervisor is assigned within two weeks.
documents.F08: Connect to the campus wireless network with your student ID and portal password.
documents.F09: Report a lost student ID card at the administration office and pay a replacement fee.
documents.F10: Students can take a leave of absence for up to two semesters by submitting a form to the faculty.
documents.F11: On-campus housing is available for first-year students. Apply through the housing office before July.
documents.F12: Midterm and final exam timetables are published in the student portal one month in advance.
